title: MKA/MACsec: Handle ES and SC bit both unset
description:
Store information about the SAKs in a file scoped list, so it is reset
when the file is closed, instead of inside the UAT table.

Add an expert info when the E bit is set and the C bit is clear in
MACsec ("the frame is not processed by the SecY but is reserved for
use by the KaY", which means we cannot decrypt and we don't know if
the ICV is 16 octets or if there is a ICV) and also an expert info
when the E bit is clear and the C bit is set ("[s]ome cryptographic
algorithms modify or add to the data even when integrity only is
provided, or use an ICV that is not 16 octets long" - no such Cipher
Suite is defined in 802.1AE-2018 or 802.1X-2020, so we cannot decrypt
and also don't know the length of the ICV.) Don't attempt decryption
in those cases.

Fix the case where the ES bit is set and the SCB bit is set.

If the SC bit and the ES bit are both clear, meaning that the SCI
is both not explicitly included and the MAC address portion is not
taken from the Source MAC of the frame, then try all SCIs of active
participants seen for a given SAK. Participants can be passive,
see IEEE 802.1X-2020 9.4.6, but this works for a case with Arista
routers where a chassis MAC and a port MAC are alternately used,
and both use the same SCI based on one of the MACs.

Eliminate a double-fetch, remove some possible cases of overflow.

AI-Assisted: no
